title: Run integration frontend without server.js

input.requestedOutcome: Disable server.js entirely for the operation-backend integration deployment.

output.summary: Replaced the integration deployment entrypoint with a static frontend host.

removed: Legacy server.js routes from integration deployment

details: No database or migration code runs.

verification.command: node --check static-server.js; local curl smoke for /health, /, app, dashboard adapter, and /api/load
verification.evidence: Health 200; root redirects; app/script 200; legacy API 404.

decisions: Use a static host rather than repairing the retired monolith.
Keep only GET/HEAD static serving and reject traversal.
risks: Legacy-only routes, including embeds and OIDC, are unavailable on this integration deployment.
followUps: Verify Railway serves the new commit and Dashboard emits /v1/dashboard.
rollback: Restore node server.js in package.json and railway.json.
